research_question: What is the effect of exercise therapy, compared with control (no treatment, placebo, waiting list or health educational material, including exercise plus a co-intervention versus that co-intervention alone), on functional ability in the short term (up to 3 months) in people with patellofemoral pain syndrome?
control_label: Control (no treatment, placebo, waitlist, education, or co-intervention alone)
outcome_description: Self-reported knee functional ability in the short term (up to 3 months post-randomization) measured by validated knee-function questionnaires (preferring Anterior Knee Pain Scale / Kujala, followed by FIQ, WOMAC function, or Lysholm).
positive_direction: Greater functional ability / better knee function in the exercise therapy group compared with the control group.
search_queries: patellofemoral pain syndrome exercise therapy functional ability trial
anterior knee pain exercise control trial Kujala WOMAC function
patellofemoral pain exercise therapy short term functional outcome controlled trial
inclusion_criteria: Empirical studies evaluating exercise therapy (alone or combined with a co-intervention) compared to a control condition (no treatment, placebo/sham, waitlist, educational material, or the co-intervention alone) in individuals with patellofemoral pain syndrome.

Reports quantitative outcomes assessing knee functional ability or functional disability via validated self-reported questionnaires (e.g., Anterior Knee Pain Scale/Kujala, FIQ, WOMAC, Lysholm) at short-term follow-up (up to 3 months).
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, narrative reviews, protocols, editorials, and commentary papers are excluded).
No comparison between an exercise therapy group and an eligible control group (e.g., comparing two active exercise interventions without an inactive or co-intervention control).
No quantitative outcome data on functional ability permitting effect size calculation (means and SDs, change scores, t-statistics, or exact p-values).
Completely unrelated to patellofemoral pain syndrome (or conducted in healthy asymptomatic individuals, post-surgical populations, or animal/in vitro models).
moderators_to_extract: Exercise type (e.g., knee/quadriceps-focused vs hip-focused vs combined hip and knee exercise)
Control type (e.g., true control/no treatment/waitlist vs education vs co-intervention alone vs sham/placebo)
Measurement instrument (e.g., AKPS/Kujala vs WOMAC vs FIQ vs Lysholm)
Follow-up duration within the short-term window (e.g., <=6 weeks vs >6 to 12 weeks)
Supervision level (fully supervised vs home-based/unsupervised vs mixed)
effect_size_note: Scores on scales where higher values represent greater impairment/disability (such as WOMAC function subscale) must be inverted so that positive effect sizes consistently indicate better functional ability. AKPS/Kujala is prioritized when multiple scales are reported.
